scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run dev --workspace @worldview/viewer
scripts.dev:editor: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run dev --workspace @worldview/editor
scripts.dev:collaboration: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run dev --workspace @worldview/collaboration-service
scripts.dev:collaboration:celld: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && celld dev apps/collaboration-service --port 8787 --logs
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run build --workspace @worldview/compiler-service && npm run build --workspace @worldview/collaboration-service && npm run build --workspace @worldview/viewer && npm run build --workspace @worldview/editor
scripts.test:browser: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run test:consumer && playwright test

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
